notes.title: Patch 1.3.2b
notes.content:
Hey Dreamers!

My apologies for the blunder - the 1.3.2 version came with an unexpected bug. This little patch should fix the black screen / soft-lock issue when switching between the head and the body in several spots of The Crypt. [b]A big THANK YOU to Dean C. and Georgie G who submitted videos, which made it so much easier to pinpoint the issue[/b]. 

Thank you all for understanding & your patience! [b]Please make sure your build is updated to the 1.3.2b version[/b] (it shows in the top-right corner of the pause menu). 

Any other issues, let me know - Lloyd will get it fixed immediately ːlloyd_happyː

notes.title: Patch 1.3.2
notes.content:
Hey Dreamers!

A big thank you to those of you who submitted videos & stayed in touch to help me troubleshoot & bring you an even better, more stable build!

[h2]Fixed issues[/h2]
[list]
[*]Some of you reported a soft-lock after solving the Bell Puzzle in The Crypt. It's now fixed. 
[*]Some of you reported an issue that involved the head resetting its position in the rotating disk/coin puzzle. It's now fixed. 
[*]Some of you reported issues with wireless controllers. No changes to the input system have been made in a very long time, so this was tricky to troubleshoot. Luckily, thanks to the report by @angelo.scarnata we now know that wireless controllers work as previously [u]if you run Steam client as Admin[/u]. I'll do my best to investigate this further, but at least we have a working solution.  
[/list]

[h2]On my to-do list[/h2]
I'm not done improving DARQ. If you notice any more issues, please report them directly to support@unfoldgames.org. Apart from tweaks & fixes, here's what's on my to-do list:
[list]
[*]Support for more controllers
[*]Automatic resolution adjustment for systems that are way below our minimum system requirements (DARQ can run beautifully even on very old computers, below our minimum requirements - it just requires adjusting the resolution). I want to automate this process to improve the user experience. 
[*]Linux version! (my promise is to give it my best try - I have no prior experience with Linux. If you're a Linux user and are willing to help out with beta testing, please reach out!). 
[/list]

Thank you all! DARQ comic book & new exciting projects are coming soon!

notes.title: Patch 1.3.1
notes.content:
Hey Dreamers!

Thank you all so much for submitting bug reports! I really appreciate your patience, positive attitude & understanding (It's genuinely difficult to release a perfect & bug-free build on day one, especially when a team is small and the level (The Crypt) quite ambitious and non-linear. )

[b]I'm happy to say that most of the bugs that have been reported are now fixed[/b]. Some issues I was unable to replicate just yet, but I'm in touch with a few of DARQ's fans who graciously agreed to help troubleshoot those, so one more patch is definitely coming soon. While I'm working on the remaining issues that might take a bit more time, I wanted to release a smaller patch in the meantime, so you have a better experience with the game. 

[h2]Fixed issues[/h2]
[list]
[*]Switching between the body and the head rapidly in some cases resulted in controlling both at the same time. Not anymore. 
[*]Sometimes switching from the head to the body would result in a change in lighting. Not any more (at least, that's what it seems like. If you still experience this issue, let me know).  
[*]There were multiple unexpected collisions of lack thereof when controlling the head. Not anymore. 
[*]A never-before-discovered bug in the first level has been fixed. A big thank you to @Amöbe for [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/433550/discussions/1/2961643452370432591/]reporting[/url] it.
[*]The head no longer gets stuck in the air when it's left on the bottom of the second elevator (and when the elevator goes up)
[/list]

[h2]To be fixed soon[/h2]
Thank you to the members of this community who agreed to submit longer playthrough videos to help pinpoint what might be the cause. I'm working on these and a new patch will be released soon.
[list]
[*]Some of you reported an issue that involves the head resetting its position in the rotating disk/coin puzzle. I was unable to replicate it as of now. 
[*]Some of you reported soft-lock when "hugging the wall" on the left after solving the bell puzzle. I was unable to replicate it and I'm working on pinpointing the issue. 
[*]Some of you reported issues with wireless controllers. They seem to do with the recent Steam client update and I'm still investigating. I also heard that the issue is related to Steam Link.  I appreciate your patience as I'm looking closer into it. 
[/list]

Thank you all for the warm reception of The Crypt & The Complete Edition across all platforms! The new patch and more improvements are on their way!

notes.title: DARQ: Complete Edition is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hey Dreamers! 

[u]Today we celebrate the release of the final content expansion for DARQ:[b] "The Crypt."[/b][/u] The base game + two DLC's are now called[b] DARQ: Complete Edition[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33932460/d853c50385bcb525d5f95c3a07eacd10ba82a2bc.png[/img]

[h2]How to Install "The Crypt"[/h2]
[list]
[*] [u][b]Simply update DARQ and you're done[/b][/u]! ːlloyd_happyː
[*] The game should update automatically. If it doesn't, just restart Steam and it should do its thing. 
[*] While "The Crypt" and "The Tower" DLC's will remain listed (temporarily), you don't have to install them separately. They are already included in the updated build. 
[/list]

[h2]New Achievements[/h2]
For those of you who like a good challenge, the new achievements are now listed. There are 5 of them. [u]Big kudos to those who find all 4 skulls in The Crypt[/u]. I made sure to hide them well ːlloyd_happyː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33932460/d9f5c016fadc88d8f6a6a96908ba0ea85f2f65c9.png[/img]

[h2]Controllers[/h2]
As of now, Xbox 360, Xbox One, and most Logitech controllers are supported. This has been an incredibly hectic year, but now that The Complete Edition is released, rest assured that getting support for more controllers is at the top of my "to-do" list. 

[h2]Consoles[/h2]
Today, [b][u]The Complete Edition is also released on Xbox One and PS4[/u][/b]. The old-gen console releases will qualify for [u]free next-gen upgrades for the entire year[/u]. Physical releases of DARQ: Complete Edition for 5 consoles will follow shortly after, in Q1 of 2021. This is a big milestone for me, as a first-time developer, and I couldn't be more grateful to all of [i]you[/i]. Those of you who bought the game made it possible for it to grow, both in size (free DLC's) and in reach (new platforms). Sometimes, I have to pinch myself just to make sure that it's all real. I'm also grateful to Feardemic & Dreamloop Games - bringing DARQ to so many platforms is a Herculean task, and they've been incredible partners on this journey. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33932460/182876624dadb33090e820507c56975add275491.png[/img]

[h2]Can't Wait to Hear Your Thoughts![/h2]
Let me know what you think of The Crypt! I've worked on it for half a year, so I'm super excited to hear your thoughts. The build was well tested and should be stable. If you happen to spot any bugs, please let me know. [b]The fastest way to get support is through email ([u]support@unfoldgames.org[/u][/b]). 

Happy exploring!

Hugs

notes.title: "The Crypt" DLC is coming Dec. 4th
notes.content:
Hey, Lloyd's friends! 

Lloyd needs your help to get through the mysterious crypt, and he needs it soon! [b]Mark the date - [i]The Crypt[/i] DLC is launching next week, on December 4th[/b]! As promised, [u][b]it will be free for all of you to enjoy. [/b][/u] 

Check out the new trailer (which features some never-before-seen footage of [i]The Crypt[/i])!

[previewyoutube=TXnA81Bsd1I;full][/previewyoutube]
Excited for [i]The Crypt[/i]? Keep reading!

[h2]The Crypt[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33932460/52ac20d5f021ff604ae9bee48ae6334a0c71d96c.png[/img]

[i]The Crypt[/i] will be at least twice as long as [i]The Tower[/i]. [b]The average playtime varies between 40 to 60 minutes[/b]. Finding all hidden collectibles and unlocking extra achievements will likely take about 1 hour. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/433550/extras/2.gif[/img]

It's also the most challenging level in the game - at least that's what our beta testers say! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33932460/dc331c7d1d1014ef74f221e709c7a99338a7f0f4.png[/img]

[h2]New Achievements[/h2]

The Crypt will introduce [u]5 new achievements[/u]. Most are pretty difficult to unlock, so it's a treat for those of you who like a good challenge. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33932460/d9f5c016fadc88d8f6a6a96908ba0ea85f2f65c9.png[/img]

[h2]Console releases[/h2]

[i]DARQ: Complete Edition[/i], which will include the base game plus [i]The Tower[/i] and [i]The Crypt[/i] DLC's, will launch on PS4 and Xbox One on December 4, too! Those who purchase DARQ: Complete Edition on PS4 and Xbox One will be able to upgrade to the next-gen builds in early 2021. The free upgrade will be available for the entire year, until 2022. 

Switch, PS5, Xbox Series S|X, as well as physical releases of all console ports are expected in early 2021 as well. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/433550/extras/1.gif[/img]

[h2]TIGA Award Nomination[/h2]

Ok, this is a bit overwhelming, but...[b]DARQ is nominated for the TIGA's Best Adventure Game Award[/b], alongside...[i][b]The Last of Us Part II[/b][/i] (!), and other awesome games. I'm blown away and can't quite describe what an honor it is for a first-time developer. 

[h2]Thank You[/h2]

[i]The Crypt[/i] took hundreds of hours of work. It ended up being the most ambitious level in the entire game. As always, thank you for your support for DARQ. Your belief in this project and in me means more than words can say. Also, thank you for being patient - it definitely took some time to get [i]The Crypt[/i] to the point where it felt like the best level of DARQ. I feel extremely fortunate to be able to spend months working on something for the sole purpose of making it cool, something that I get to share with you. It wouldn't have been possible without your support. I don't take any of it for granted. 

Wlad

notes.title: The Audiobook is out!
notes.content:
Happy Spooktober! 

[b]I'm excited to announce that my book "GAMEDEV" is now available as an AUDIOBOOK[/b]- [u]it's narrated by Yong Yea[/u], and he's amazing at it!

[list]
[*] [b][url=https://www.audible.com/pd/B08JNCT5DY/?source_code=AUDFPWS0223189MWT-BK-ACX0-216833&ref=acx_bty_BK_ACX0_216833_rh_us]Audible[/url][/b] ([u][b]Free with Audible Trial[/b][/u] - bounty link)
[*][b][url=https://www.amazon.com/dp/B08CBLXPB7]Amazon[/url] [/b](audiobook, ebook, and paperback). 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33932460/febe59f2d5884f3bdddafc161d6da4453cbc16e2.png[/img]

[h2]What is the book about?[/h2]

[u]This book assumes no knowledge of game development on the reader's / listener's part[/u]. [b]It offers a sneak peek into my story and all the hardship and obstacles I had to overcome to make DARQ[/b].

In this book, I also share practical advice on how to go from knowing nothing about game development to making video games for a living (if that's something you're interested in). The book covers [b]mindset, preproduction, funding, business, law, development, marketing, PR, publishing, distribution, as well as pre-launch, launch, and post-launch strategies[/b]. [u]I hope it helps some of you, even if you're not interested in game development. [/u]

[h2]The book features advice from the following industry professionals[/h2]

[list]
[*][b] Quentin De Beukelaer[/b] (Game Designer of [i]Assassin's Creed Unity[/i] and [i]Ghost Recon Breakpoint[/i])
[*][b] Mark Kern[/b] (former lead for [i]World of Warcraft[/i], producer of[i] Diablo II[/i] and [i]Starcraft[/i])
[*][b] Bjørn Jacobsen[/b] (Sound Designer of [i]Cyberpunk 2077[/i] and [i]Divinity: Fallen Heroes[/i])
[*][b] Austin Wintory[/b] (Grammy-nominated composer of [i]Journey[/i])
[*][b] Wojciech Piejko[/b] (Lead Designer of [i]Observer [/i]and[i] The Medium[/i])
[*][b] Barbara Kciuk[/b] (Narrative Designer of [i]Blair Witch[/i])
[*][b] Rami Ismail[/b] (Developer of [i]Nuclear Throne[/i] and [i]Super Crate Box[/i])
[*][b] Dan Adelman[/b] (Biz Dev of [i]Chasm [/i]and [i]Axiom Verge[/i])
[*][b] Scott Millard[/b] (Publisher, Managing Director at Feardemic, Former Managing Director at Bandai Namco)
[*][b] Stephen McArthur[/b] (Video Game Attorney)
[*][b] Toms Martin[/b] (Video Game Investor)
[/list]

[h2]What others had to say[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33932460/a7e98bcd974e062703a447c21ea8bea115743833.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33932460/f323723a227e54a8615b77cad39805b66265f53a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33932460/47a02ddfc2d7e1e756a49f0c28cb4dfc4515ec22.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33932460/514d733dee391040571091b228b9b3b82ac4203e.png[/img]

[h2]Have a fun Spooktober! [/h2]

[b]To celebrate Lloyd's favorite month, DARQ is now 60% off. If you ever wanted to pick up the game or gift it to your friends, now is a good time[/b]. 

[u]Thank you all so much for your support![/u] As I'm writing this, I'm finishing up [i]The Crypt[/i] - it's the most ambitious level I've ever designed and I can't wait to share it with you all (a couple of months from now). And yes, it's going to be free. 

In the meantime, consider checking out the book: 
[list]
[*] [b][url=https://www.audible.com/pd/B08JNCT5DY/?source_code=AUDFPWS0223189MWT-BK-ACX0-216833&ref=acx_bty_BK_ACX0_216833_rh_us]Audible[/url][/b] ([u][b]Free with Audible Trial[/b][/u] - bounty link)
[*][b][url=https://www.amazon.com/dp/B08CBLXPB7]Amazon[/url] [/b](audiobook, ebook, and paperback). 
[/list]

Much love to all, and as always, thank you for your support! More exciting announcements are coming soon!
Wlad

notes.title: "The Crypt" Development Update + Console Releases
notes.content:
Hi Everybody!

[b]This week marks DARQ's 1st Anniversary[/b], so I've got some [u][b]big news[/b][/u] to announce!

[h1]The Crypt[/h1]

The 2nd DLC is still in development, but it's for a good reason. I set the bar high, especially that "The Crypt" will be the final content expansion for DARQ.[b] I want to bring you as much value as possible[/b] - my goal is to make it as amazing as it can be. [b]The level became quite ambitious. It's large and features the most challenging puzzles you've seen in DARQ yet[/b]. It introduces [b]new game mechanics and comes with a set of new achievements[/b]. As you will see, the environments got better and more detailed too. 

The main mechanic involves being able to switch between the body and the head: 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/433550/extras/SteamSpinningRoom.gif[/img]

This DLC will also be much more tense than "The Tower."

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/433550/extras/FinalFullSteam.gif[/img]

If you want to see more, be sure to check out the trailer: 

[previewyoutube=MGrAMPqDDLk;full][/previewyoutube]

[u][b]As promised, "The Crypt" will be free for all of you to enjoy[/b][/u]. It might take a few more months to finish, but I hope you don't mind waiting just a bit more. It will be released by the end of 2020, along with the console relea....wait, WHAT??? 

[h1]Console Releases[/h1]

I know some of you have been waiting for this announcement for a while![b] I'm thrilled to announce that I've partnered up with the publisher [i]Feardemic[/i], subsidiary of [i]Bloober Team[/i][/b] (devs of [i]Layers of Fear, Observer, Blair Witch[/i]) to bring DARQ to consoles. 

If you've followed me for a while, you may already know that I've received many offers from publishers in the past. Having spent a lot of time dealing with publishers, including those who tried strongarming me into signing terrible deals, I haven't been able to find the right partner for DARQ - [u]until now[/u]. [i]Feardemic [/i]and [i]Bloober Team[/i] are the leaders in the horror genre, so since the beginning, our creative visions aligned. [i]Feardemic[/i]'s team has been fair and accomodating to me since day one - I'm very happy with this partnership and it feels like the perfect fit. 

[h2]Which consoles? [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33932460/bf4709e6e997c7db7a2dcc8383a6ebb11f8471aa.jpg[/img]

DARQ, along with the two free DLC's ("Complete Edition"), is coming to:
[list]
[*]XBOX ONE
[*]XBOX SERIES X
[*]PS4
[*]PS5
[*]NINTENDO SWITCH
[/list]

[u]IMPORTANT[/u]: [b][url=https://www.feardemic-games.com/darq]If you want to be notified when DARQ launches on consoles, subscribe to Feardemic's Newsletter[/url].[/b] 

[h3][b]When?[/b][/h3]

We're aiming to release the complete edition of DARQ on all platforms by the end of 2020[/u]. "The Crypt" DLC will be released on Steam and GOG around the same time (for free). 

[h3][b]What about physical distribution?[/b][/h3]

All console releases will have both physical and digital distribution worldwide. Digital is expected in late 2020, while physical can come a bit later, in early 2021. 

[h3][b]What exactly does Feardemic do?[/b][/h3]

To clarify, [b]DARQ remains my intellectual property, and [i]Feardemic[/i] has no creative control when it comes to the game and its contents[/b]. DARQ will remain self-published on the PC. [i]Feardemic[/i] will simply bring DARQ to consoles. 

[h3][b]Will you make more games after DARQ?[/b][/h3]

Most definitely. [u]I have a few game projects lined up, so stay tuned for more exciting announcements! Apart from that, there are a couple of DARQ-related "side projects" that I'm thrilled to share with you.[/u]

Speaking of the upcoming projects...[b][u]I'm incredibly grateful to all of you[/u] for providing me with the opportunity to continue to make games[/b]. It's a rare privilege that not many indie developers get to experience - I certainly don't take it for granted and will continue to do everything I can to [i]show [/i]that to you. Going the extra mile with this free DLC is just one of the ways to express my gratitude. I can't wait to share with you what I've been working on! 

While making games is [i]a lot[/i] of hard work, I absolutely love the process- I can't believe that I get to do it. It also blows my mind that DARQ has won so many awards recently. For example, [b]being nominated alongside Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, Borderlands 3, Death Stranding[/b]... There are times when I have to pinch myself! After all, DARQ became #42 Most Shared PC Video Game of 2019 (Metacritic). None of it would have happened without your support. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33932460/7d75115809d9d4c8bf1800d3f29391e13d8b6f28.jpg[/img]

[u]I'll always be thankful to you and be on your side - mark my words[/u]. 

In the meantime, I hope you join me in wishing Lloyd a Happy (1st) Birthday! He's been through a lot and needs a bit of cake before [i]heading[/i] over to the Crypt ;)

notes.title: X Box Controllers Support & D-Pad
notes.content:
Dear DARQ fans,

This patch (1.2.2) is here to fix some of the issues you might have encountered when trying to play DARQ with X Box controllers. A few notes and commonly asked questions & answers: 

[list]
[*][b]What controllers are supported as of now?[/b]
X-Box One (Wired / Wireless), X-Box 360 (Wired / Wireless), Steam Controller. Also, as per your request, D-Pad is now functional.[u] Support for more controllers will be added in the future[/u]. 

[*][b]Can other controllers work with this patch?[/b]
While not tested, if your controller shares X Box key mapping, it should work. Please note, these patches are quick fixes to some of the issues we overlooked in the 1.2 update (my apologies!).[u] Adding support for more controllers is definitely on our to-do list[/u].

[*][b]Run button (RT) doesn't work[/b]
Please go to[i] Steam Settings / Controller / General Controller Settings[/i] and [u]uncheck [/u]any presets you may have selected. This should restore RT button functionality. (While selecting X Box Preset solved some of the issues in the previous patch, this patch doesn't require any presets to be active)

[*][b]Nothing's changed, my (X Box) controller still doesn't work[/b]
Please make sure that the game has updated to 1.2.2 version. You can check the build version in the top-right corner of the pause menu. If it doesn't say 1.2.2, restart Steam Client and let the game update to the most recent version. 

If that doesn't help, make sure all controller presets in Steam Settings ( [i]Steam Settings / Controller / General Controller Settings[/i]) are unchecked. 

[/list]

If you continue to encounter any issues with X Box controllers, please comment below. I appreciate your diligence in reporting problems and patience as we troubleshoot & resolve issues. I'm  dedicated to resolving issues as soon as possible and your positive attitude means a lot to me (as some of the issues surprisingly require more time to solve & test than it may seem)

P.S.: Stay tuned for the upcoming 2nd free DLC, it's entering production next week :)

notes.title: 1.2.1 Controller Patch
notes.content:
Dear DARQ fans,

I appreciate all of your reports regarding a controller bug that came with 1.2 Update. In some cases, the bug made it impossible to play the game with controllers that were supported in the previous build. My sincere apologies for this blunder - lesson learned. I'll do my best to prevent issues like that from happening in the future. 

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2][list]
[*] As we spend much-needed time with in-depth testing of the PS4 (and other) controllers, I want to offer you a quick fix:[u] this patch will bring back the system that had already worked, so currently [b]X Box One / X Box 360 (both wired and wireless) should work correctly[/b]. [/u]
[*] When using a controller,[b] now you can exit the inventory with the B button[/b] (previously, the only way to exit the inventory was to select an empty slot or click Select). 
[*] For keyboard users, [b]now you can navigate the pause menu with either [i]ASWD + E[/i] or with[i] arrows + enter[/i][/b], regardless of what control scheme is currently chosen. This has been requested multiple times and I'm happy to make it happen in this patch.
[*] [b]You may find that non-X Box controllers might work as well[/b] (if they share X Box key mapping), but we haven't tested them with the current build and cannot guarantee anything but X Box controllers to work correctly at this time. 
[/list]

Thank you for your understanding and patience as we continue to improve & test our input system. We'll do our best to add support for more controllers once we have the opportunity to test things properly. 

[b]Most importantly, thank you all for the warm reception of the DLC - it means the world to me.[/b]

[*] [b]You may find that non-X Box controllers might work as well[/b] (if they share X Box key mapping), but we haven't tested them with the current build and cannot guarantee anything but X Box controllers to work correctly at this time.

notes.title: "The Tower" DLC is out!
notes.content:
[b]I'm excited to announce that today marks the release of "The Tower"[/b] - a free DLC that I'm so thrilled to share with you. 

[h2]How to play "The Tower"[/h2][list]
[*] [u][b]This DLC requires a 1.2 Update (or higher)[/b][/u], so make sure your DARQ build is up to date. When in doubt, you can verify the version you have in the pause menu (upper-right corner). The 1.2 build has DLC section in the pause menu:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33932460/f5a0af5afb1c9cd995500a885b979927e484099e.jpg[/img]

[*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1210400/DARQ__The_Tower/]Go to "The Tower"[/url] page and click [b]DOWNLOAD[/b].

[*]Before running DARQ,  make sure that the DLC is marked as "Enabled / Installed" on your DLC list.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33932460/bf5c2ac3e07c4e8489e81b0a8cfe2866b0a182fd.jpg[/img]

[*]In DARQ, go to the [b]Pause Menu[/b] and enter the [b]DLC[/b] section - you'll be able to access the list of available DLC's. It's one for now, but we've already started working on the second one, which as promised, will be free as well. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33932460/935449fd00ccc504037235e921f1f2f535dd0c41.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[b]Hope you enjoy this level! [/b]A lot of hard work and heart went into it. I can't wait to hear from you. Consider writing a review or leaving a comment - all feedback means a lot to me and helps me improve the game. 

P.S.: If you encounter any issues with controllers, please know I'm already on it and will be patching it up shortly. 

[h2]Special 50% Discount[/h2]
Recently I've received a number of comments mentioning that the price point for DARQ is a bit too high when it comes to the amount of content offered. Message received. [b]In addition to this free DLC (and future free expansions), DARQ is now temporarily being  offered at a half price[/b], so even more people can (hopefully) enjoy it. If you recently purchased the game at a full price, you can request a refund and re-purchase it at the discounted price. [b]Please consider spreading the word about this promotion, or if you can afford it, gifting the game to your friends who might enjoy it. It would help accelerate the production of the second free DLC[/b].

[h2]Thank You[/h2]
Big credit and much gratitude goes to [b]Davide Pellino[/b] and [b]Felipe Torrents[/b] (3d artists), [b]Bjørn Jacobsen[/b] (sound designer who was just nominated for a Game Audio Award for this very game), [b]Kelsey Haley[/b] (2d artist), [b]our incredible team of translators[/b] (all listed individually in the game's end credits), and [u][b]all of YOU[/b] who purchased this game - it's thanks to you the creation of this DLC was possible. [/u]

notes.title: 1.2 Update is here (required to play DLC)
notes.content:
1.2 Update is now out![u] [b]Make sure you update the game before you play [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1210400/DARQ__The_Tower/]"The Tower" DLC[/url][/b],[/u] (which launches tomorrow). 

[h2]Notes:[/h2][list]
[*][b]This update introduces 4 achievements.[/b] Two of them you can unlock in this update even today, as you wait for the DLC release. The other two are unlockable in the DLC (tomorrow) and their description will show up as the DLC releases.[list]
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33932460/9e96d9e0ef17e7594da5e659eb6114e579e64715.jpg[/img]
[b]Perceptive[/b]
Trigger 3[i] [u]secret[/u] [/i]encounters with the bag-headed boy. To clarify, the secret encounters required to unlock this achievement are different from those triggered automatically as you progress through the game. Some of those are well hidden. 

[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33932460/2ece0432f027942e67efa2728a304c41ee14b6f0.jpg[/img]
[b]Off Camera[/b]
Solve the rotating camera puzzle (on the train level) before the camera completes the first rotation. Fair warning: this is difficult. Easily the most difficult achievement to unlock in the game. 
[/list]
[*][b][strike]PS4 controller support[/strike][/b] 
[u][b]EDIT: I've received some feedback about controller detection issue. I just released a 1.2.1 patch that fixes it, but PS4 controller will need a bit more time to be implemented properly. Sorry about the inconvenience. [/b][/u]
[*][b]Danish language is now available from the settings menu[/b]. We're working on implementing Arabic, which should be available in the next update. If you want DARQ to be available in your language and it's missing, request it in the comments!
[*][b]Minor bug fixes. [/b] Thank you for reporting bugs and being patient as we address all issues that come up. 
[*][b]DLC functionality[/b] - you will be able to play "The Tower" DLC as soon as it becomes available tomorrow. Make sure it's marked as "Installed" on your DLC list. Once it is, you can play the level by accessing it from the pause menu. 
[*][b]The default control scheme for keyboard has been changed to ASWD + E[/b]. The game will remember your previous choice if it wasn't ASWD + E.
[/list]

[b]"The Tower" is launching tomorrow, on Steam and GOG, expect it the morning of Pacific Time Zone. [/b] Can't wait to see you all play it!

notes.title: Steam Award Nomination + DLC Update
notes.content:
Hi & Happy Thanksgiving!

A few people have posted comments about nominating DARQ for a Steam Award. [u][b]Thank you so much for your vote of confidence and all your support, it truly means a lot to me![/b][/u] If you haven't voted yet, [b]please consider nominating DARQ for one of those awards[/b] - it would be a dream come true for me to see DARQ get a nomination. 

[h1]DLC Update[/h1]

[b]I'm excited to say that the first DLC ("The Tower") is almost finished[/b]. This turned out to be quite an ambitious project - it's currently the largest level in the game. Here's a little sneak peek into the development / modeling: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33932460/fa29c8082bc2bf48bcdb8347e6345763fbbe0ff3.gif[/img]

I (and a small team of contractors) am aiiming to finish it before the end of the year. I'm so excited to show it to you. As promised, all DLC's will be available for free. One more DLC will follow early next year. Although DLC's will be slightly more challenging than the rest of the game, playing them will not require finishing the main campaign. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/433550/extras/Render-Animation.gif[/img]

Happy Thanksgiving to you all, and thank you for your ongoing support!

notes.content:

Thanks to the overwhelming support we've received from the community we were able to expand the team and begin production of the first DLC. Since the recent update we've been hard at work on the first expansion: "The Tower."

Here's a sneak peek from "The Tower:"

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/433550/extras/DLC.gif[/img]

notes.title: DARQ: 1.1 Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33932460/602c69618dafa594fc069fc9faa50db94e752a7e.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone! 

Thank you for your patience as we were preparing this update. There's a few more things left on our to-list that we're currently addressing (thank you for reporting issues and suggesting improvements). More updates will follow. 

[h1]Update Notes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b][u]Controller[/u][/b]

[list]
[*] In addition to [b]Steam Controller[/b], DARQ now supports [b]X-Box One[/b] and [b]X-Box 360 controllers[/b], both [b]wired [/b]and [b]wireless[/b]. 
[*] Now running can be triggered by both [b]RT[/b] and [b]L3 [/b](pressing the left stick)
[*] The game can now be unpaused with [b]"B"[/b] Button
[*] Now both [b]"X"[/b] and [b]"A"[/b] buttons can be used in the pause menu
[/list]

Please note: [i]we'll be releasing more updates soon that will add support for more controllers - the list of all supported controllers will be kept up to date in the System Requirements section. [/i]

[*] [b][u]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/u][/b]

[list]
[*] Reloading chapters no longer resets brightness
[*] Train Level: dying while picking up the dynamite no longer disables the inventory / prevents from picking up the dynamite again. Sorry if you experienced this bug!
[*] Hospital Level: now the screw cannot be moved when out of view
[*] Cave Level: Fixed the bug that caused the wrap-head monster to appear too early in some cases (in the last section of the level)
[*] Improved edge walking in stealth mode

[/list]

[/list]

More improvements are coming soon! Now that the overwhelming launch period has passed, we'll be able to address issues and improve the game a lot faster. Thank you so much for your feedback so far!

[i][b]If you have any further requests, issues, or suggestions, the best way to reach us is by email[/b][/i]: [b]support@unfoldgames.org[/b]

notes.title: Thank You For Your Support & Surprise Announcement
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33932460/57ce220ef9fe03a6b6a63987c8e8ed2e4f267953.jpg[/img]

[h1]Thank you![/h1]
The amount of support DARQ has received from the community has been incredible. I didn't expect my blog post  ([url=https://medium.com/@info_68117/why-i-turned-down-exclusivity-deal-from-the-epic-store-developer-of-darq-7ee834ed0ac7]Why I turned down exclusivity deal from the Epic Store[/url]) to result in so much good will and support. [b][u]Please know that I don't take any of it for granted and I'm truly grateful[/u][/b]. Unfold Games will always be on the side of its customers. 

[h1]Upcoming Patch[/h1]
We've been working on a patch that will add support for more controllers and fix a few bugs. Big Thank You to the community for providing feedback and reporting issues, as well as your patience - the patch should be out in a few days. 

[h1]Surprise Announcement[/h1]
The feedback we've received has been overwhelmingly positive, which is a dream come true for a first-time developer. Something that has been mentioned quite a lot since the launch is that DARQ could use a few extra levels. Message received! I'm excited to announce that we're planning to release additional levels for DARQ later this year.[u][b] To acknowledge all the support we've received from the community and express our grattitude, DARQ DLC's will be available for free[/b][/u].

notes.title: DARQ is launching tomorrow!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33932460/213a8ac5027fb14fa50d8980d8e680a430ddbff0.jpg[/img]

[h1]It's TOMORROW[/h1]

Hey dreamers! The launch day is almost here! DARQ will launch tomorrow, [b][u]August 15th at 10am ET[/u][/b]! Thank you everybody for wishlisting the game and patiently waiting for its release. We couldn't be more excited to share this game with you all. 

[h1]Launch AMA[/h1]

Two hours after the launch, at 12pm ET, the developer of DARQ will be answering questions in the AMA format on reddit, in [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Games/]r/Games.[/url] Stop by if you have any questions or just want to chat!

[h1]Frequently asked questions[/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]Does DARQ support a controller?[/b]
Yes, DARQ supports X Box Controller and is configured to work with Steam Controller as well. 

[*] [b]Does DARQ have soundtrack?[/b]
Although we recently made an announcement about DARQ soundtrack, in the end we realized that the game needs very little music. Most of it was removed from the final build, as it makes the game better. We might release all the music that didn't make it to the game at a later date, for free. 

[*] [b]What can I do to support the project & its developers?[/b]
It would mean a lot to us if you leave a Steam review after playing the game. 

[*] [b]Is there technical support?[/b]
Yes. We worked very hard to ensure a bug-free experience on launch and according to the reviews, DARQ plays well, is well optimized and stable. It's not unusual however to miss a few bugs on launch, and we're totally ready to address any issues, if any, [u]immediately[/u]. You can report bugs in the community forum or email us at support@unfoldgames.org - if there are any issues with the game, you have our word that they will be addressed instantly. 

[/list]

Thank you for following this project, this really means the world to us! Exciting day tomorrow!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33932460/dfc198f4818c5d99783eb7acfcd0a4379b3292aa.jpg[/img]
